package — see Configuration."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## What it is (and is not)"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"`agy` is a **complete agent** with its own tools, terminal sandbox, and approval

- Antigravity's own tool use is **not** reported as harness tool c"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"alls, and DSH

keeps its "},{"id":"p12s4","text":"own tools; Antigravity answers from the text it was given.
- Because Antigravity *has* tools, it wil"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"l try to use them on task-shaped

which is the single most important thin"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"g to understand about this route."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Choose the MCP path instead if you want DSH tools driven by Antigravity, or

Antigravity's tools exposed as DSH tools."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Tool handling: why `textOnly` matters (default on)"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"This is the failure that shaped the plugin, so it is worth stating plainly."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"`agy` decides on its own whether a prompt needs a tool. Ask it something
task-shaped — *"check wheth"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"er this directory is writable"* — and it calls its own
`run_command`. In print mode there is nobody "},{"id":"p16s3","text":"to answer the approval prompt, so
the call is **auto-denied**, the agent stops, and the turn ends wi"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"th an empty
response. The CLI reports this honestly (`denied_actions:
[{"action":"command","display_"},{"id":"p16s5","text":"name":"RunCommand"}]`), but the harness only sees
a model that produced no text."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"With `textOnly: true` (the default) the adapter provisions a small custom agent
and selects it with "},{"id":"p17s2","text":"Only: true` (the default) the adapter provisions a small custom agent
and selects it with `--agent`:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"That agent is instructed to answer from the conversation alone and never to
reach for tools, which t"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"urns the route into what the harness expects. The file
is created only when it is missing, so an age"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"nt you wrote yourself is never
overwritten; set `geminiConfigDir` to relocate it, or `provisionAgent"},{"id":"p19s4","text":": false` to
manage the file yourself."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"If Antigravity still ends a turn on a denied tool call, the adapter raises an

Antigravity to act on"},{"id":"p22s2","text":" the machine — and accept that its tools then run outside
the harness sandbox, with no DSH approval "},{"id":"p22s3","text":"d accept that its tools then run outside
the harness sandbox, with no DSH approval in front of them."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"### What tool mode actually does"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Measured on a real run with `textOnly: false` and `skipPermissions: true`:"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- `agy`'s `init` event reports **57 tools** and `permission_mode:
always-proceed`, so nothing is den"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"ied and no `denied_actions` come back;
- `run_command` executes **in the configured `cwd`** (or the "},{"id":"p25s3","text":"session workspace
when `cwd` is empty) — `pwd` returns that directory;
- file-producing tools may in"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"stead write into Antigravity's own scratch area,
`~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/scratch/`, so an artifac"},{"id":"p25s5","text":"t the model reports as
"created" can land outside the workspace you expected. Use `addDirs`
(`agy --"},{"id":"p25s6","text":"add-dir`) to bring another root into the session workspace, and check
the reported path rather than "},{"id":"p25s7","text":"assuming `cwd`;
- the harness still receives **text only**: Antigravity's tool traffic never
becomes"},{"id":"p25s8","text":" DSH tool calls, so nothing appears in the DSH transcript as a tool
invocation and no DSH tool execu"},{"id":"p25s9","text":" tool calls, so nothing appears in the DSH transcript as a tool
invocation and no DSH tool executes."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Because the last point surprises people, the two tool layers are worth keeping
apart: `textOnly` con"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"trols **Antigravity's** tools, while the harness's own tools
(bash, read, write, web) are never in p"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"lay on this route whether `textOnly` is on
or off."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Why GitHub and not npm"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"There is no official DSH plugin registry: a plugin is an ordinary package, and
discovery happens thr"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"ough the GitHub `dsh-plugin` topic. This repository is
distributed that way, and `private: true` sta"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"ys set for one concrete reason —
